findings: The inspected original machine contracts expressly prohibit external I/O at L10 and all network/file/audit/new locks after FinalGuard. They do not expressly provide a general local-file exception.

No equally explicit whole-transaction local-file ban was found in these original machine-contract passages. New bootstrap interface comments/proposal restrictions must not be presented as pre-existing broader contract.
Neither absence of a broad ban nor a memory snapshot proves late changed/deleted material should be accepted. The original current-material/ref/lifecycle guarantees still need concrete evidence.

A1/D2 should explicitly locate resource Recheck relative to the fixed FinalGuard: either review bounded original local-file validation before final independent guard with all original deadlines/context and no work afterward, or supply a concrete original immutable-version/current revocation source. Do not silently delete old validation or declare an unreviewed local-I/O exception.
Nonce global config prefix remains A1 L1, retained nonce range A2 L5, final readback must acquire no new earlier business locks.
